Releasing AXLE: the Axiom Lean Engine :gear:

Hey all! We're publicly releasing the core Lean metaprogramming infrastructure we built for AxiomProver (the system we used for Putnam and some research conjectures) here at Axiom. We're calling it AXLE.

It handles proof verification, manipulation, and Lean runtime stuff — basically the plumbing we wished existed when we started. We've been using it internally for a while and figured it might be useful to others working on similar problems.

There's an interactive playground if you want to poke around without any setup:
https://axle.axiommath.ai

API docs are here: https://axle.axiommath.ai/v1/docs/

More context on what it does and why we built it: https://axiommath.ai/territory/releasing-axle

If you need more capacity for the API, fill out this form and we'll get back to you: https://forms.gle/CdLKu45tEsRXtFQ29

Happy to answer questions here or at axle@axiommath.ai . Would love to hear what's missing that would be useful!

Discussion thread at #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Axiom Lean Engine
